title: What's New (v4.4.3)
summary: Daily stats cloud sync is more reliable, sync states are clearer, manual sync is available in Settings, and backup diagnostics are stronger.

bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Daily stats sync is more reliable, including sessions ended manually

## Fixes

- Sync status is now clearer with visible success, pending, and failure states
- You can now trigger a manual sync from Settings when needed
- Improved stability and diagnostics for cloud backup and restore

## Why this matters

What's New (v4.4.3) is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the app feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- Daily stats sync is more reliable, including sessions ended manually gets a little more room to breathe.
- Sync status is now clearer with visible success, pending, and failure states gets a little more room to breathe.
- You can now trigger a manual sync from Settings when needed gets a little more room to breathe.
- Improved stability and diagnostics for cloud backup and restore gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
